name: @pipeworx/mcp-resident-advisor

tools.name: ra_search_areas
tools.description: Look up Resident Advisor area ids by city/region/country name (e.g. "London", "Berlin", "Tokyo"). Returns each matching area with its numeric id, event/venue counts and country — the id is what ra_event_listings needs for its area_id argument.

query.description: City, region or country name to search for, e.g. "London".

tools.name: ra_event_listings
tools.description: List Resident Advisor electronic music events for an area (city) and date range, optionally filtered by genre (e.g. "techno", "house", "disco"). Get area_id from ra_search_areas first. Returns event id, title, date, venue and genres for each listing, plus the total match count.

area_id.description: Numeric RA area id from ra_search_areas, e.g. 13 for London.

date_to.description: End date, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to date_from + 30 days if omitted.

tools.name: ra_event
tools.description: Get full details for a single Resident Advisor event by its numeric id (from ra_event_listings): description, times, cost, venue, lineup/artists, genres and promoters.

tools.name: ra_artist
tools.description: Look up a Resident Advisor artist/DJ by name (resolved via RA search) or by numeric id, returning their profile (follower count, country, links) and upcoming/latest listed events.

name.description: Artist/DJ name to search for, e.g. "Carl Cox". Ignored if artist_id is given.

artist_id.description: Numeric RA artist id, if already known.

tools.name: ra_venue
tools.description: Look up a Resident Advisor venue/club by name (resolved via RA search) or by numeric id, returning its profile (address, capacity, area, top artists) and upcoming/latest listed events.

name.description: Venue/club name to search for, e.g. "Ministry Of Sound". Ignored if venue_id is given.

venue_id.description: Numeric RA venue id, if already known.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-resident-advisor forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the resident-advisor pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
